metadata.name: YC & Speedrun Launch Monitor Agent
metadata.short_description: Monitors YC Directory, Speedrun, X/Twitter, and LinkedIn for early founder launch signals & official batch additions with Slack alerts.
metadata.description: A high-speed GTM pipeline intelligence agent. Continuously monitors Y Combinator and Speedrun startup launches across social channels and official directories. Specifically detects early founder announcements on X and LinkedIn before official directory publication.
metadata.key_features:
• Continuous 4-source monitoring (YC Directory, Speedrun, X/Twitter, LinkedIn)
  • Early founder signal detection before official YC social/directory announcement
  • Persistent stateful SQLite deduplication engine (8-hour cadence)
  • Interactive Slack Block Kit alert delivery with outreach actions
  • Automated status and health monitoring API
metadata.use_cases: Empower GTM and BD teams at fintechs, banks, and dev-tool companies to connect with high-potential YC and Speedrun founders before competitors.
metadata.setup_instructions: Configure your SLACK_BOT_TOKEN and target SLACK_CHANNEL_ID in environment variables, then submit your Pond Access Key.

faqs.question: How does early founder detection work?
faqs.answer: The agent monitors social data streams from X and LinkedIn for verified founder announcements mentioning acceptance into YC or Speedrun before YC lists them in their public directory.

faqs.question: Does it avoid duplicate alerts?
faqs.answer: Yes. The agent maintains a persistent SQLite database tracking all seen launches, transition states, and post IDs across continuous polling cycles.

pricing_plans.name: Community Plan
pricing_plans.description: Free continuous monitoring and Slack alert dispatching.

actions.name: Run Agent
actions.description: Send any natural language query, search, or instruction to the YC & Speedrun Launch Radar.

input_schema.description: Input parameters for querying and running instructions on the YC & Speedrun Launch Radar.

prompt.description: The prompt or question to send to the Agent (e.g., 'show early signals', 'search fintech', 'check status').

actions.name: Check New Launches
actions.description: Executes an immediate incremental scan across all 4 sources and returns newly detected early signals and confirmed launches.

input_schema.description: Configuration parameters for scanning social feeds and directories for new launches.

sources.description: Specific sources to scan (optional). If empty, all 4 sources are scanned.

items.description: The source platform identifier to monitor.

send_slack_alerts.description: Whether to send formatted Block Kit alerts to the configured Slack channel for newly found items.

actions.name: Search Monitored Companies
actions.description: Searches the persistent database for companies, founders, or batches.

input_schema.description: Parameters for querying companies, founders, or batches in the verified database.

query.description: Keyword, company name, founder handle, or batch to search.

status_filter.description: Filter results by announcement status (all, early_signal, or confirmed).

actions.name: Get Monitor Health & Stats
actions.description: Retrieves current daemon uptime, total tracked companies, early detection count, and last scan timestamps.

input_schema.description: Parameters for retrieving daemon uptime, tracking stats, and health metrics.
